children: WisdomTree, Inc. (NYSE: WT), a global financial innovator, today announced that Luba Spear was named “CMO of the Year” at the 2026 Wealth Management Industry Awards. The recognition highlights WisdomTree’s continued focus on innovation and delivering solutions and resources that help financial advisors better serve their clients and grow their businesses.

Since becoming Chief Marketing Officer in 2024, Spear has continued to evolve WisdomTree’s global brand and marketing strategy, sharpening how the firm communicates its capabilities across traditional and emerging areas of finance. Under her leadership, the marketing organization has focused on bringing WisdomTree’s differentiated investment expertise and culture of innovation to life through compelling, integrated messaging that resonates with financial advisors and investors.

“I am honored to receive this recognition, which reflects the creativity, collaboration, and commitment of our entire marketing team,” said Spear. “WisdomTree has always been defined by a willingness to innovate, and our role in marketing is to bring that story to life in ways that are clear, relevant, and meaningful to our clients. I’m incredibly proud of what our team has built and how we continue to evolve alongside the firm.”

“Luba has been instrumental in shaping how WisdomTree tells its story and communicates the breadth of who we are today,” said Jarrett Lilien, President and Chief Operating Officer at WisdomTree. “She brings together a deep understanding of our business, our clients, and our culture, and has built a marketing organization that reflects the innovative spirit of the firm. This recognition is well deserved and a testament to the leadership and impact she brings to WisdomTree every day.”

Now in its 12th year, the Wealth Management Industry Awards celebrate the companies, individuals, and organizations that demonstrate outstanding achievement in support of financial advisor success. A panel of independent judges, consisting of some of the industry’s most respected leaders, determined the finalists and winners from hundreds of submissions.

This year’s awards were presented at a ceremony in New York on the evening of September 10, 2026. More information about the 2026 Wealth Management Industry Awards and the judging process can be found

WisdomTree is a global financial innovator, offering a diverse suite of exchange-traded products (ETPs), models and solutions, private market investments and digital asset-related products. Our offerings empower investors to shape their financial future and equip financial professionals to grow their businesses. Leveraging the latest financial infrastructure, we create products that emphasize access and transparency and provide an enhanced user experience. Building on our heritage of innovation, we offer next-generation digital products and services related to tokenized real world assets and stablecoins, as well as our institutional platform, WisdomTree Connect™, and blockchain-native digital wallet, WisdomTree Prime®*, and have expanded into private markets through the acquisition of Ceres Partners’ U.S. farmland platform.
